You will be led through some guided imagery to foster awareness, which won’t take long at all; then there will be a period where we just sit quietly together until everyone is ready for the next step (it may feel like nothing). Then after 20 minutes or so of silent sitting you can open your eyes and join with others in sharing what felt most alive during this time.
The live session will last approximately one hour, followed by a period for participants to share their experience if desired; we may also have some music or chanting at the end
